title.zh: 美国法官驳回针对Kelsier Ventures及Meteora的Libra集体诉讼
title.en: 美国法官驳回针对Kelsier Ventures及Meteora的Libra集体诉讼

current_state.zh: A US federal judge dismissed the class action against Libra token organizers Kelsier Ventures, Meteora and developer Benjamin Chow, rejecting fraud, RICO, New York business-law and unjust-enrichment claims and denying the plaintiffs' request to file an amended complaint.
current_state.en: A US federal judge dismissed the class action against Libra token organizers Kelsier Ventures, Meteora and developer Benjamin Chow, rejecting fraud, RICO, New York business-law and unjust-enrichment claims and denying the plaintiffs' request to file an amended complaint.
